description: Extract schema-valid JSON from text/HTML or document images. Pay per call via x402 V2.
name: io.github.noamjose/schemasure

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of SchemaSure. Text has free V1 evaluation without a wallet; image extraction is V2-only and always requires a wallet.
environmentVariables.name: SCHEMASURE_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM key. Enables paid x402 V2 text and image calls; signs Base USDC payments locally. Never sent to SchemaSure.
environmentVariables.name: SCHEMASURE_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Client-side spend cap in USD per call (paid mode). The client refuses to pay more than this, even if the server advertises a higher price.
environmentVariables.name: SCHEMASURE_MAX_PRICE_USD

title: SchemaSure — structured extraction
